description: Tell TownIndex that a listing is wrong: the business closed or moved, or its phone, hours or website are wrong. A person reviews every report before anything changes. Use it only for what you have good reason to believe (the user said so, a web page shows it, or a call didn't go through), and ask the user before sending it.

basis.description: How you know: the user said so, a web page shows it, or a call to the listed number didn't go through.

id.description: The business id from search_businesses or get_business.

message.description: What is wrong and, if known, what is right ("moved to 12 Main St", "the number is disconnected", "the website says closed since March"; a web page's address helps).

name: report_listing_issue
title: Report a problem with a listing
